description:
A personal Kanban and GTD task manager, on the desktop.

Hae is a task manager built around Kanban boards and the Getting Things Done method:
projects hold columns, columns hold cards, and a card carries a description, checklists,
labels, members, comments and attachments.

This is the desktop build of the application also available on mobile and on the web, so
the same account and the same boards follow you across all three. An account is required.
